arms.clean: Use the sampled base-teacher preference orientation without corruption.
arms.flip_20pct: Flip each training pair orientation independently with probability 0.20.
arms.flip_40pct: Flip each training pair orientation independently with probability 0.40.

artifact_policy: Retain this protocol and lock, exact runner snapshot, all generated comparison designs and labels, all policy metrics, environment, summary, and SHA-256 manifest. Never overwrite a run or discard null/negative results. The audit must regenerate designs and labels from the frozen seed rules and reconstruct all metrics and the primary decision.
claim_boundary: A passing result supports only a controlled synthetic contextual preference-optimization mechanism under this teacher, learner, noise process, and shift. It is not language-model training, reasoning, truthfulness, alignment, or capability evidence.

data.context_distribution: Independent standard-normal features sampled using random.Random(seed).gauss(0, 1).
data.label_sampling: For an unordered action pair (a,b), select a with probability sigmoid(u(x,a)-u(x,b)); otherwise select b. Label draws use separate deterministic RNG streams from context/pair design.
data.noise_condition: Use one uniform draw per training example from random.Random(seed + 5000000); flip at thresholds 0.20 and 0.40. The 20% flipped examples are therefore a subset of the 40% flips, and both conditions retain the original unordered action pair.
data.shifted_teacher: u_shift(x,a) = u(x,a) + 1.25*x[0]*[-1.5,-0.5,0.5,1.5][a]. This changes preference labels while keeping held-out contexts and action pairs matched to the base evaluation set.
data.splits: Training, held-out comparison design, base-teacher labels, and shifted-teacher labels use independent declared seed offsets. No held-out examples or metrics are used to choose hyperparameters or alter the protocol.

gradient_check.method: Central finite differences on a fixed four-action, eight-feature preference minibatch and fixed nonzero parameter vector.

learner.objective: Mean softplus(-beta * ((log pi(chosen|x)-log pi(rejected|x)) - (log pi_ref(chosen|x)-log pi_ref(rejected|x)))).
learner.policy: Contextual categorical policy pi(a|x)=softmax(theta[a] dot x), initialized with all theta=0.
learner.update_budget_selection: Fixed at 100 for every trained arm, carried over as a fixed experimental setting from the prior synthetic study. This study has no development phase or budget tuning.

metrics.interpretation: Only the clean-arm in-distribution primary rule determines acceptance. Noise and shifted-condition results are reported per seed and descriptively; no monotonicity or robustness claim is assumed in advance.
metrics.primary: Per-seed held-out base-teacher pairwise NLL improvement: reference NLL minus clean-arm NLL. Positive is better.
secondary: held-out pairwise NLL, accuracy, Brier score, mean KL to uniform, and teacher expected utility for each arm under both base and shifted labels
realized training flip count and fraction for each noise arm
per-seed parameter delta and wall-clock seconds

purpose: Measure how fixed-budget contextual preference optimization responds to independently flipped training labels and a known held-out preference shift, with regenerated data and a frozen primary acceptance rule.
